title: Enola Holmes 3
plot_overview: A young detective travels to Malta with hopes of marriage, but those plans unravel when a family disappearance draws her into a dangerous case. She must follow clues through unfamiliar surroundings while confronting difficult questions about independence, love, and finding her own voice.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like light period mysteries, charismatic leads, and stylish adventure, though fans seeking the breezy energy of earlier entries may be disappointed; Not for you if you prefer tightly focused mysteries.
review_summary: Pros: charming lead performance; gorgeous locations; playful visual style | Cons: weaker mystery; overstuffed plotting; diminished whimsy
